title: Verify: Fallback texture and key resolution
summary: Unit tests for resolveKey and effect context
description: Test BootScene.resolveKey and effectContext key usage with mocked Phaser.
acceptance_criteria: unknown and failed ids return fallback

steps.action: Mock phaser; construct BootScene; assert resolveKey('objects/bed') returns 'objects/bed', resolveKey('nope') returns 'fallback:missing'; add 'objects/bed' to failed via the registered loaderror handler (captured from a mocked load.on) and assert resolveKey('objects/bed') returns 'fallback:missing'. Separately call createPhaserEffectContext with a fake scene whose add.particles is vi.fn returning chainable setDepth and resolveKey=()=>'fallback:missing'; createEffect a dust spec and assert particles third arg is 'fallback:missing'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneFallback.test.ts
